title: How should AI Safety Benchmarks Benchmark Safety?
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any specific aspect of faith or religion. It is a meta-analysis reviewing the methodology of 210 AI safety benchmarks in general, covering topics like toxicity, bias, and manipulation, under which religious bias could theoretically fall but is not explicitly analyzed.
findings: The paper presents no findings related to religion, as its focus is on the general methodology of AI safety benchmarking, not on specific types of harm like religious bias.
